integrity.computational_scope: exhaustive small rings only; no infinite certification

scientific_limitations: Only determinant-equals-zero 2x2 fibres over finite commutative chain rings and their unnormalized additive Fourier-convolution operators are covered.
Determinant-equals-zero is not equivalent to determinant-nonunit over length greater than one.
Earlier specialized or general local quadratic-form and Smith-invariant Fourier calculations may yield an equivalent specialization; the search is bounded.
The finite computations do not establish the unbounded theorem; the analytic proof does. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Universal Fourier spectrum of the determinant-zero cone over finite chain rings
